issue.title: Dependabot ownership split + limited auto-merge
issue.body:
## Parent

Part of #420 (Phase 3). Do not close #420 from this ticket.

## Scope

- Remove or ignore Expo/RN-coupled packages from Dependabot's `expo` / `react` / `react-native` groups so they cannot fight weekday `expo install --fix` (Phase 2).
- Enable GitHub auto-merge (squash) for **safe** Dependabot labels only, still one lockfile merge at a time **or** rely on merge queue (Phase 4).
- Keep ignore rules for `react-native >= 0.87`, React minor/major, `op-sqlite` major.

Risk tiers: see #420.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Dependabot no longer owns Expo/RN-coupled packages.
- [ ] Auto-merge policy documented and limited to the risk tiers in #420.
- [ ] Agent commands (`handle-dependabot`, `dep-bump`) and `docs/guides/dependabot-process.md` match.

## Out of scope

Weekday Expo sync job (Phase 2), merge queue (Phase 4), SDK 58+.
